name: skylark_check_in_flight
intent: Check in for a SkyLark flight
description: Checks in for a SkyLark flight by opening My Trips, selecting the trip to the requested city, selecting the passenger, confirming no hazardous materials, and confirming check-in, then returns the seat, gate, and boarding information.
patterns: Check me in for my flight
Check in for my upcoming trip

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: The destination city of the flight to check in for.

steps.intent: Tap My Trips to find the flight to {{trip_city}}
Select the trip to {{trip_city}} from the list
Tap Check in for the selected flight
Tap Continue after selecting the passenger
Toggle the declaration that I'm not carrying hazardous materials
Tap Continue after confirming the hazardous materials declaration
Tap Confirm check-in to complete check-in
